lanes.name: Source custody and preservation
lanes.description: Every public or private review must first know where records came from and how they were preserved.

lanes.name: Agency / department identity
lanes.description: Canonical agency records, source labels, subunits, jurisdictions, budgets, staffing, and identifiers.

lanes.name: Incident normalization
lanes.description: Future incidents, roles, dates, locations, force, injuries, deaths, and downstream processes.

lanes.name: Officer identity and career timeline
lanes.description: Future officer entity resolution, employments, ranks, badges, POST IDs, separations, and aliases.

lanes.name: Civilian, family, witness, survivor privacy
lanes.description: Privacy, dignity, consent, display minimization, and family narrative boundaries.

lanes.name: Lawsuit corpus
lanes.description: Civil and criminal case carriers, claims, procedural history, dispositions, appeals, and counsel.

lanes.name: Settlement and cost accounting
lanes.description: Payouts, funding source, no-admission terms, linked cases/incidents, and dollar totals once earned.

lanes.name: Discipline, complaint, arbitration, and decertification
lanes.description: Complaint outcomes, IA, arbitration, certification, decertification, reinstatement, and appeals.

lanes.name: Policy, contract, union, and reform timeline
lanes.description: Policy versions, union terms, discipline procedures, oversight structures, and reform milestones.

lanes.name: Brady/Giglio and credibility disclosure
lanes.description: Public credibility disclosure surfaces, testimony linkages, prosecutor duties, and defense-use access models.

lanes.name: Death-in-custody and fatal force
lanes.description: Fatal police violence, custody deaths, medical examiner/coroner records, and family packet surfaces.

lanes.name: Wandering officer and mobility detection
lanes.description: High-confidence employment, misconduct/adjudication, separation, certification, and hiring signals.

lanes.name: Denominators, rates, and peer comparison
lanes.description: Population, staffing, budget, agency type, calls, arrests, encounters, missingness, and denominator proof.

lanes.name: Research and empirical analysis
lanes.description: Qualified immunity, consent decrees, policy effects, settlement costs, concentration, and model caveats.

lanes.name: Public display and role access
lanes.description: Public pages, role-specific views, copy states, display minimization, and access boundaries.

lanes.name: Correction, right of reply, rollback
lanes.description: Corrections, contested entries, source updates, appeals/reversals, rollback propagation, and tombstones.

lanes.name: Cross-system justice misconduct
lanes.description: Prosecutorial, jail/prison, ICE/CBP, school, private security, forensic, and judicial-adjacent surfaces.

lanes.name: International and comparative accountability
lanes.description: Non-US systems, translation, legal comparability, and source safety.
